title: TX queue C conformance: generate priority/expiry scenario expectations
description: Round-2 correctness review found that gen_vectors.py validates selected bounded/implementation cases but does not consume behavioral cases from tx_queue_expiry.json or tx_queue_priority.json, and main.c still uses independent handwritten behavior literals. Generate C expectations from the canonical expiry boundary/default cases and priority FIFO/alias/preemption cases, then drive the corresponding host tests from those generated values.
acceptance_criteria: Generated header contains scenario-derived expectations from expiry and priority vector cases; C tests use those generated expectations for exact expiry boundaries, ACK/routing FIFO ordering, and priority/preemption behavior; divergence in any of the four required vector files fails generation or CTest; sanitizer-backed tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
